hooks.command:
python3 -c "import os, sys; not os.environ.get('TMUX') and (sys.stderr.write('[Hook] BLOCKED: Dev server must run in tmux for log access
[Hook] Use: tmux new-session -d -s dev "cargo run"
[Hook] Then: tmux attach -t dev
') or sys.exit(1))"

PreToolUse.description: Block cargo run outside tmux - ensures you can access logs

hooks.command: python3 -c "import os, sys; not os.environ.get('TMUX') and sys.stderr.write('[Hook] Consider running in tmux for session persistence\n[Hook] tmux new -s dev  |  tmux attach -t dev\n')"

PreToolUse.description: Reminder to use tmux for long-running commands

hooks.command: python3 -c "import sys, json, subprocess; d=sys.stdin.read(); i=json.loads(d); p=i.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''); p and subprocess.run(['cargo','fmt','--','--edition','2021'],capture_output=True); print(d,end='')"

PostToolUse.description: Auto-format Rust files with cargo fmt after edits

hooks.command:
python3 -c "import sys, json, subprocess, os; d=sys.stdin.read(); i=json.loads(d); p=i.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''); r=subprocess.run(['cargo','clippy','--message-format=short','--','- D','warnings'],capture_output=True,text=True,cwd=os.path.dirname(p) or '.') if p else None; lines=[l for l in (r.stdout if r else '').split('
') if p and os.path.basename(p) in l]; lines and sys.stderr.write('
'.join(lines[:10])+'
'); print(d,end='')"

PostToolUse.description: Lint Rust files with clippy after edits

hooks.command: python3 -c "import sys, json; d=sys.stdin.read(); sys.stderr.write('[Hook] Test run completed - review results above\n'); print(d,end='')"
